headline: Central Fronts Hold While Base Lines Shift
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the struggle narrowing onto a handful of unsettled fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest theatre, with 88 strategic-base events in 24 hours and a present count of one Warden, four Colonial, and four neutral bases; its last two-hour window records two events amid sharply rising casualty rates. Mooring County has steadied only briefly, posting 48 events in the day and six in six hours, while retaining ten Warden and two Colonial bases. Callahan’s Passage has fresh movement—three events in two hours and 23 in the day—though all ten bases currently stand Warden-held. Nevish Line has also quickened, with six recent events and 20 across 24 hours, leaving seven Warden and one Colonial base. Gutter’s Kuoppa accounts for all six of that region’s daily events, including six in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow records two events at Mox and now lists one Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral base. Elsewhere, most ledgers show no recent base action, despite renewed enlistment and casualty activity on several fronts.
